name: nutrium
description: Appointment requests for guests and nutritionists

scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd backend && bundle install && bin/rails db:prepare
scripts.security: cd backend && bundle exec brakeman --quiet --no-pager --exit-on-warn --exit-on-error && bundle exec bundler-audit check --update
scripts.openapi: cd backend && RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rake rswag:specs:swaggerize
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:sync && git diff --exit-code -- backend/swagger/v1/openapi.yaml frontend/src/api/generated && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- backend/swagger/v1/openapi.yaml frontend/src/api/generated)"
scripts.check: pnpm api:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm security
